path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

command.description: Command interpreted by the selected shell in the current working directory.

anyOf.description: Use ordinary stdout/stderr pipes and a writable stdin. shell_control can send chars or close stdin with eof.
Use pseudo-terminal semantics for REPLs, TUIs, and terminal prompts. shell_control can send chars; eof is rejected for PTY sessions.

io_mode.description: Process transport. Defaults to pipe. PTY output is returned in the same normalized session result format.

yield_time_ms.description: Maximum initial observation window in integer milliseconds, default 10000, range 10000 to 60000. Earlier exit returns earlier; expiry leaves the process running for shell_control.

action.description: Observe this session and optionally deliver chars or eof before observing. Omit chars and eof for a read-only wait.

session_id.description: Short opaque session_id returned by bash in this agent run. Pass it unchanged to shell_control; never use an OS PID.

chars.description: Empty or omitted chars means no input.

eof.description: No stdin is closed during a read-only wait.

yield_time_ms.description: Observation budget in integer milliseconds. Read-only waits use 10000-300000; waits that write chars or EOF use 500-60000. Default 10000 for a read-only wait.

chars.description: Optional exact UTF-8 text sent to the session, at most 65536 bytes. No trimming or appended newline. Include \n when required. PTY sessions receive this as terminal input.

eof.description: Pipe sessions only. After optional chars, permanently close the pipe stdin. PTY sessions reject eof with error code eof_not_supported. EOF is not process termination or Ctrl+C.
